causalSource.meaning: Arrow navigation schedules focusFirst via setTimeout.
data-highlighted reflects isFocused; aria-selected combines isSelected and focus.
Delegates controlled value and change callback to canonical adopted Select; no custom keyboard handler.
Group by uses existing controlled local state and Client/None options.

proposedAssertions: After focusing each combobox, assert it is focused.
After opening with Enter, assert expanded/listbox visible and exact currently selected option focused.
After ArrowDown, assert exact next option focused before final Enter.
Keep the original selected client, visible task, None value, one table, regroup and phone screenshot checks unchanged.
prohibitedSubstitutions: No click selection in the keyboard sequence.
No arbitrary wait, retry, timeout increase, assertion removal or changed expected value.
No shared Select or application runtime edits.

nearbyAudit.otherKeyAction: next-modules-task-links.spec.ts uses Escape followed by URL assertion; it does not repeat this ArrowDown/Enter pattern.
